name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original Blender procedural panel meshes with user-supplied reference-image textures
accuracy_notes: Reference-led exterior panel reconstruction with independent modeled door and wheel pivots. The user-provided reference pictures show the exterior; interior materials, fittings, hinge positions and vehicle dimensions are period-inspired approximations, not verified factory specifications or a photographic match. Compressed reference images are embedded as lamp textures.

attribution.credit: Original procedural vehicle meshes and scene created for Blender-3D-Gallery.
